You’re in, Alice!

DomDimaBot is connected to your Twitch channel. Three quick steps and it’s answering in your chat — about 5 minutes.

Get it running

1

Turn the bot on

On your dashboard, open Quick Actions and click “Turn the bot on”.

2

Add your first command

Go to Commands → Add Command, name it hello, save, and type !hello in your chat.

3

Pick your modules

Text to speech, alerts, chat moderation, clips and analytics. Each card shows its plan.

Open my dashboard  →

Stuck on a step? The getting started guide walks through each one, or ask us on Discord.

You’re in, 𝄞👨‍👩‍👧‍👦!

DomDimaBot is connected to your Twitch channel. Three quick steps and it’s answering in your chat — about 5 minutes.

Get it running

1

Turn the bot on

On your dashboard, open Quick Actions and click “Turn the bot on”.

2

Add your first command

Go to Commands → Add Command, name it hello, save, and type !hello in your chat.

3

Pick your modules

Text to speech, alerts, chat moderation, clips and analytics. Each card shows its plan.
